supports.question: Is the paper visibly inside the cup, with evidence it has been stuffed into it rather than merely resting nearby or on the rim?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image shows the paper placed inside the cup and visibly stuffed into it. Fail if the paper is only nearby or on the rim, or the image shows no progress toward placing it inside. Unknown if the image does not provide enough evidence to determine whether it is inside and stuffed.
supports.binding: Assess only the requested paper-in-cup edit, using the image evidence; unrelated edits do not count as progress.

supports.question: Does the image provide enough evidence to determine whether the paper has been stuffed into the cup?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image clearly resolves whether the paper is inside the cup and stuffed into it. Fail if the image clearly shows it is not stuffed into the cup. Unknown if visibility or ambiguity prevents a determination; retain this as unresolved rather than inferring completion or absence.
supports.binding: Use only visible evidence of the paper’s placement relative to the cup; do not treat proximity or contact with the rim alone as proof of stuffing.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: Combine the supports under the frozen target: complete only when the paper is visibly inside the cup and evidence shows it has been stuffed into it; absent only when there is no progress toward that requested change; partial when there is some progress but the target is not complete. Unrelated edits are not progress. If required evidence remains insufficient or unresolved, report unknown rather than assuming complete, partial, or absent.
